items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Now that band that consisted of during them times... and Mercedes Gorman, the San Piano Piano... and I was on the drum.

ctx.x: So Paul Barch wasn't doing that band anymore then? Who? Paul Barch was gone. Oh no, no. He was up in New York that time.

Paul Barch wouldn't play in the band that time, got to play in 1930. And then during that time when Joe Ruzon got hoisted, had like a B or something, he kind of hoisted his mouth, so we replaced him with this fellow Caesar Thornton. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, he's from St. Louis, and he came down here on the boat. Not too much with sax, but he was a good arranger. They had him play with the band, he finished it there, and then he started arranging for the band while he was on the seasoned job. And then come down, and…
